answer: The Dedicated device bound by in-person pickup code with a public binding record makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Like a terrace on a key ring, one odd key hides easily, so the check runs on every binding rather than a sample. A ivory and a gale may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
